text:
dina: Deploy-bot flagged a spike for model-2.4.5 in us-west — latency + output-regression. Auto-action suggested partial fallback. Anyone seeing customer impact?

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary error-rate 7.2% (threshold 5%), p95 latency 2.3x baseline. Suggested action: traffic-shift 30% -> model-2.4.4 over 10m. autopin=false. :warning:

luis: seeing increased rerank failures hitting the dedicated alfa-queue, ~20 calls/min failing with 5xx. Investigating logs now. :eyes:

meredith: if dedicated pools are affected we should avoid a blanket revert. Prefer targeted traffic-split for dedicated pools + a customer comm for impacted tenants.

ryan: agree w/ targeted. Proposal: shift 20% for dedicated pool in us-west for 10m, monitor error-rate and tail latency. If error-rate drops <2% then continue ramp, else full rollback + pin.

dina: oncall, can you run the split and post the command you used so we have an auditable action? also pls add a short note to release-notes that we initiated a mitigation.

oncall-ops: running command now: `redwoodctl rollout traffic --model=2.4.4 --percent=20 --region=us-west --duration=10m --selector=pool:dedicated --reason="canary_regression"`

oncall-ops: action started at 3742002400 — traffic shift in progress. I will post metrics in 5m slices.

deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic-shift started (id=ts-3742002400). Monitor window open.

luis: after 6m error-rate down to 1.9% for the dedicated selector, retries decreased. Logs show fewer rerank timeouts.

meredith: Good. I'll draft a customer note for affected tenants: brief, apology, mitigation steps, ETA for follow-up. Tagging legal in draft loop.

dryan: (typo) -> ryan: If we don't see sustained improvement by +15m from start, we should escalate to full rollback and pin 2.4.4 across us-west. Prep the pin command: `redwoodctl pin model --env=prod --region=us-west --model=2.4.4 --reason="regression_rollback"`

dina: noted. I'll own the pin exec if needed. For release-notes: mark as "reverted model 2.4.5 in us-west due to output regression; investigating root cause" — keep customer-facing wording non-technical.

oncall-ops: update at 3742004200: metrics at 8m show error-rate stable at 1.8%, p95 back to 1.1x baseline. Holding the split and continuing monitoring for full 10m.

meredith: publishing customer note to affected tenants and posting on the status page now. Draft: "We observed increased failures for a subset of inference requests after a model update. We rolled a portion of traffic back to the previous model and are monitoring; no data loss. We'll update with a root-cause & timeline." Sending to legal for sign-off.

luis: continuing log tail; saving traces for the infra/serving team. Will attach sample request ids to the incident ticket.

dryan: (ryan) thanks — once monitoring completes, let's decide on full rollback or safe ramp. If it's stable we'll proceed with a cautious ramp back to 2.4.5 after RC sign-off.

dina: leaving this thread open. If oncall sees a reversal I'll trigger the pin command. Thanks all. :pray:
